seo.title: Accessibility Statement | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: How the Lasan Marine website supports accessibility: WCAG 2.2 level AA as the target, built-in reading aids, known limitations and how to send us feedback.

fields.headline: Accessibility statement
fields.lead: Lasan Marine Co., Ltd. wants everyone to be able to read and use this website, including people who use screen readers, keyboards, screen magnification or need less motion.

fields.content:
The standard we aim for

The site is built and checked against the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA. It is currently partially conformant: most content meets the standard, and the remaining limitations are listed below.

Reading aids on the site

The Accessibility button on the right edge of the screen (bottom corner on phones) opens a panel of options. Your choices are kept in the browser you use:

  • Text size: enlarges the whole page in four steps.
  • High contrast: darker text and borders, no gradient type.
  • Grayscale: shows the site without colour.
  • Underline links: makes every link easy to spot.
  • Readable font: switches to a plain, wide typeface.
  • Text spacing: line, letter, word and paragraph spacing per WCAG success criterion 1.4.12.
  • Stop animations: turns all motion off; the site also follows your operating system’s “reduce motion” setting.
  • Large cursor and reading guide: a clear band that follows the pointer to keep your place.

What the site already does

  • A “Skip to main content” link at the top for keyboard users.
  • Everything works with a keyboard, with a clear outline on the focused element.
  • One main heading per page and an ordered heading structure; navigation, content and footer are marked as landmarks.
  • Informative images have text alternatives; decorative icons are hidden from screen readers.
  • Every form field has a label.
  • Content is available in Vietnamese and English, and each page declares its language.

Known limitations

  • The 3D simulators (ship stability, steel hull structure…) draw with browser graphics, so screen readers cannot yet read the drawing. The main results can be exported to Word or Excel; if you need them in another form, contact us.
  • Technical drawings and project photos have short descriptions, not a full description of every detail.
  • Third-party content such as Google Maps and Zalo follows that provider’s accessibility support.

Feedback

If anything on this site is hard to read or use, call or message us on Zalo at +84 834 310 781, or email hello@lasanmarine.com. We will fix it, or send you the information in a form that works for you.

This statement was prepared on 25 November 2026 and will be updated as the site changes.

fields.heading: Trouble using the site?
fields.description: Tell us which page, what you were doing and which device or assistive technology you use; we will fix it or send you the information another way.
